checked.claim: SIP pass rule per block / Tertial
checked.official_value: 60% of scored questions in each block (SIP4a) or subject (SIP5a) AND 60% overall. Overall below 60% means the whole exam is repeated. Overall reached but 1 or 2 subjects (fewer than half) below 60% means only those are repeated.
checked.source: SIP4a Ausschreibung for the 1 Jul 2026 sitting (archive doc 5856138765080201879), p1-2 p2; SIP5a Ausschreibung for the 24 Sep 2026 sitting (archive doc 5278226464154625336), p1-3 p2

checked.claim: SIP attempts and commission rule (archive: 5 attempts, attempts 4 and 5 commission, oral part contested)
checked.official_value: Failed exams may be repeated 4 times (5 attempts), a 6th if it is the very last exam of the study. If all attempts are used, admission ends and re-admission is excluded. Attempt 4 ('k 4') and attempt 5 ('k 5', the UN 996 202 group) are commission attempts: after the written exam the board reviews it. The June 2025 sheet states that for Nostrifikanten the board reviews the written exam, while regular-study candidates sit an oral part. So for Nostrifikanten no oral part is stated for attempt 5.
checked.source: MedUni Wien Merkblatt Nostrifizierung Humanmedizin, edition 1 Sep 2026 (current on the Antragstellung page, read 2026-10-10) p9; SIP4a Ausschreibung for the 1 Jul 2026 sitting (archive doc 5856138765080201879), p1-2 p1; SIP5a Ausschreibung for 27 Jun 2025 (archive doc 5397884845726660011), p1-2 p1
checked.fix: Add to SoT. Wording note: the sheets do not define 'UN 996 202'; read as the Nostrifikant group because the 2025 sheet contrasts Nostrifikanten with regular study.

checked.claim: Stichprobentest structure: exactly 10 subjects, 250 MCQ, one attempt, positive at 6 of 10 fields at 60% each (SoT 1.1)
checked.official_value: Subjects and counts confirmed: 30 each Innere, Chirurgie, Kinder; 25 each Neurologie, Gynaekologie, Dermatologie, Notfall; 20 each HNO, Psychiatrie, Augen (total 250). A field is positive at 60% of questions. 6 or more positive fields: exams only for the negative fields (plus maybe a thesis). 5 or fewer: exams of the regular curriculum. One attempt only. The test is electronic (i-med). It is a measure inside the procedure, not an exam under the UG.
checked.source: MedUni Wien Merkblatt Nostrifizierung Humanmedizin, edition 1 Sep 2026 (current on the Antragstellung page, read 2026-10-10) p6-8; i-med.ac.at Termine Stichprobentest 2027 PDF, p1 (https://www.i-med.ac.at/studium-services/media/Termine-Stichprobentest-2027-1.pdf, read 2026-10-10)
checked.fix: Keep. The Merkblatt says 'questions', not 'MCQ'; keep our MCQ wording only if another source confirms it.

checked.claim: What a Vienna Nostrifikant sits after the Stichprobentest, and whether the result decides the list
checked.official_value: Yes. The Bescheid lists the exams: 6 or more positive fields means exams for the negative fields only; 5 or fewer means regular-curriculum exams; Rezeptierkunde and Gerichtliche Medizin always. Exams are taken in the order given in the curriculum, are in German, and the Bescheid sets a deadline (length not stated). All prescribed SIP parts must be taken at the same sitting. Admission as extraordinary student comes first.
checked.source: MedUni Wien Merkblatt Nostrifizierung Humanmedizin, edition 1 Sep 2026 (current on the Antragstellung page, read 2026-10-10) p2, p7-8; Info-Blatt Pruefungsanmeldung Human (archive doc 5861958308327333788), p1
checked.fix: Add a short 'what happens after the test' block to the SoT.

checked.claim: How to register for SIP4a/5a: by email or Med.Campus? (archive: both reported)
checked.official_value: Nostrifikanten use the SIP4a or SIP5a registration form sent by email from the university student account, inside the window; late or incomplete forms are not considered. The calendar also says Nostrifikanten register through the Studienabteilung (it names a different general mailbox). Deregistration is online in Med.Campus up to 3 full working days before. No-show without deregistration means a 3 month block (extended over teaching-free periods).
checked.source: MedUni Wien Nostrifizierung, Pruefungen page, read 2026-10-10; Info-Blatt Pruefungsanmeldung Human (archive doc 5861958308327333788), p1; MedUni Wien Pruefungskalender (SIP), page read 2026-10-10
checked.fix: Add to SoT: email form, student account, window only, 3 working days to deregister.

checked.claim: C1 German level is needed for Vienna nostrification (SoT has no level rule; blog says Vienna requires C1)
checked.our_value: No rule in SoT. Blog: Vienna currently requires C1.
checked.official_value: C1 proof is required at filing. Accepted: OeSD C1, Goethe C1, telc C1 (also C1 Hochschule, C1 Beruf), DSD II, TestDaF level 4 and 5, OeIF C1 test, C1 certificate of an Austrian university language centre, DSH 2 and 3, German-language school-leaving certificate, or a 3-year degree taught in German. The certificate must not be older than 3 years from the exam date. A German FSP and a course attendance certificate are not on the list.
checked.source: MedUni Wien Merkblatt Nostrifizierung Humanmedizin, edition 1 Sep 2026 (current on the Antragstellung page, read 2026-10-10) p2-4; MedUni Wien Ermittlungsverfahren page, read 2026-10-10
checked.fix: Add the C1 rule and the list to SoT section 1.1. The blog line about Vienna is right.
